WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_disbursement
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY loan_year
),
values AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2023 THEN total_disbursement END) AS val_2023,
    MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2024 THEN total_disbursement END) AS val_2024
  FROM yearly_totals
)
SELECT
  (val_2024 - val_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(val_2023, 0) AS percent_growth
FROM values;
